trigger_summary: Unexplained tachycardia at rest (HR 119.0) with positive trajectory acceleration.

differential_diagnosis.reasoning: Unexplained tachycardia at rest, especially in a hospitalised patient (MOHFW Cardiac Emergency Protocol 2022, Section 2.3).
Post-operative, immobile patient with new onset tachycardia (MOHFW Cardiac Emergency Protocol 2022, Section 2.3).
New-onset tachycardia exceeding 120 BPM at rest (MOHFW Cardiac Emergency Protocol 2022, Section 2.3).
No known blood loss, dehydration, or pain/anxiety (MOHFW Cardiac Emergency Protocol 2022, Section 2.3).

recommended_actions.action: Obtain ECG to rule out cardiac arrhythmia.
recommended_actions.rationale: Mandatory for all new-onset tachycardia exceeding 120 BPM at rest (MOHFW Cardiac Emergency Protocol 2022, Section 2.3).

recommended_actions.action: Assess for sepsis risk factors (altered mental status, hypotension, fever).
recommended_actions.rationale: Early recognition of sepsis is critical (MOHFW Sepsis Management Protocol 2023, Section 2.1).

recommended_actions.action: Review patient's cardiac history and genomic risk for cardiac conditions.
recommended_actions.rationale: Patient's cardiac history and genomic risk may influence diagnosis and treatment (MOHFW Cardiac Emergency Protocol 2022, Section 2.3).
